import collections

csv := [
    "date,region,product,quantity,unit_price",
    "2026-04-01,north,notebook,10,200",
    "2026-04-01,east,marker,6,150",
    "2026-04-01,south,eraser,25,80",
    "2026-04-02,west,stapler,4,600",
    "2026-04-02,north,marker,8,150",
    "2026-04-02,east,notebook,9,200",
    "2026-04-03,south,stapler,3,600",
    "2026-04-03,west,eraser,15,80",
    "2026-04-03,north,eraser,20,80",
    "2026-04-04,east,stapler,5,600",
    "2026-04-04,south,notebook,6,200",
    "2026-04-04,west,marker,8,150",
]
map<string, int> regional
map<string, int> product_quantities
map<string, int> daily
total := 0
for row := csv[1:][]
    fields := row.split(",")
    quantity := int(fields[3])
    price := int(fields[4])
    amount := quantity * price
    total += amount
    .regional.increment(fields[1], by = amount)
    .product_quantities.increment(fields[2], by = quantity)
    .daily.increment(fields[0], by = amount)
println("total: {total}")
for (region, revenue) := collections.ranked_entries(regional)[]
    println("{region}: {revenue}")
for (product, quantity) := collections.sorted_entries(product_quantities)[]
    println("{product}: {quantity}")
day, best := collections.ranked_entries(daily)[0]
println("best day: {day} ({best})")
